submission.justification: Radiator-R3 is recommended based on the following analysis: (1) R2 is excluded as it fails the ageing requirement with 40% transparency loss, far exceeding the 10% limit. (2) Both R1 and R3 pass the ageing test, but R3 demonstrates superior performance with only 3% transparency loss versus 6% for R1. (3) Better transparency preservation is critical for maintaining photon yield over the detector lifetime, which directly impacts separation performance. (4) While direct simulation data for pion/kaon separation was not available in the analysis, R3's superior transparency characteristics make it the most promising candidate for achieving the required 3.5 sigma separation at 10 GeV/c. (5) A thickness of 3 cm is selected as a balanced choice within the 1-6 cm range, providing sufficient radiator length for adequate Cherenkov photon generation while avoiding excessive chromatic aberration that could degrade the ring image quality.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c
requirements.evidence: Simulation data for separation performance was not found in the project documents. R3 is selected based on its superior transparency (3% loss), which should provide better photon yield and separation performance compared to R1 (6% loss).

requirements.requirement: Pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma
requirements.evidence: Direct simulation results for separation at 10 GeV/c were not available. R3's superior transparency characteristics (3% ageing loss) make it the most likely candidate to meet this requirement.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after 10-year ageing test must not exceed 10%
requirements.evidence: R3 shows only 3% transparency loss after the 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test, well below the 10% limit. R1 also passes with 6% loss, while R2 fails with 40% loss.
Recommended thickness of 3 cm is within the specified range of 1-6 cm.

requirements.requirement: Must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 is one of the three candidates evaluated (R1, R2, R3).
